modeReason: The top story (AI valuations diverging from a panicked, then rebounding market) scores novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 3 = 18, well above the threshold of 8, so today stands as its own fresh slopper.
phrase: A day after trillions evaporated, one AI lab raised $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation. A rival preparing to go public is already being valued lower than hoped.
phraseAlternatives: Global markets wiped out trillions in AI stocks this week. One lab still managed to raise $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation.
One AI lab's valuation hit $1.25 trillion the same week voters rejected its data centers and markets panicked.
Investors erased trillions in tech value, then handed one AI lab $11 billion anyway. A rival going public did not get the same warm welcome.
The market lost trillions on AI fears, then recovered. One lab's funding round did not seem to notice either way.

brief.concept: One AI company's valuation keeps climbing into the trillions even as markets briefly panic, while a rival preparing to go public is already being valued lower than it hoped.
brief.metaphor: A money ladder reaching into the clouds beside a rocket that shrinks instead of launching.

cast.who: a company building climbing a tall stack of coins into the clouds
a falling stock arrow cracking through a chart beneath the building
a second company building standing on a launch pad, its rocket shrinking instead of lifting off
a small crowd of investors holding price tags of different heights

brief.composition: Split frame on one shared, cracked stock-chart ground. Left half: a company building climbs a tall stack of coins toward a cloud. Right half: a second company building stands on a rocket launch pad, its rocket visibly smaller than a dotted outline drawn above it. A small group of investors stands in the middle, some reaching up with tall price tags toward the climbing building, a few holding shorter price tags toward the shrinking rocket. No sentences in the image; numerals only if needed.
brief.alt: A building climbs a tall stack of coins into the clouds while, beside it, another building's rocket shrinks instead of launching from its pad. Between them a small crowd of investors holds price tags of different heights toward each building, all standing on a cracked stock chart.
